items.title: Chain of Responsibility Pattern
items.description: Explains the Chain of Responsibility pattern for passing requests through a handler pipeline until one handles them.

items.title: Command Pattern
items.description: Explains the Command pattern for encapsulating requests as objects to support queuing, logging, and undo operations.

items.title: Interpreter Pattern
items.description: Explains the Interpreter pattern used to evaluate sentences in a specific language by defining a grammar representation and an interpreter.

items.title: Iterator Pattern
items.description: Explains the Iterator pattern used to traverse collections without exposing their underlying representation.

items.title: Mediator Pattern
items.description: Explains the Mediator pattern used to reduce chaotic dependencies between objects by centralizing their communication.

items.title: Memento Pattern
items.description: Explains the Memento pattern used to capture and restore an object's internal state without violating encapsulation.

items.title: Observer Pattern
items.description: Explains the Observer pattern for propagating state changes to dependent objects through event-style notifications.

items.title: State Pattern
items.description: Explains the State pattern which allows an object to alter its behavior when its internal state changes.

items.title: Strategy Pattern
items.description: Explains the Strategy pattern for swapping algorithms at runtime through a shared interface and composition.

items.title: Template Method Pattern
items.description: Explains the Template Method pattern for defining an algorithm skeleton while allowing subclasses to customize specific steps.

items.title: Visitor Pattern
items.description: Explains the Visitor pattern used to separate algorithms from the objects on which they operate.
